correctness.rationale: Use the universal Euclidean covering strip and deck maps (s,y)->(s+C,+/-y). Horizontal shorter separation a is uniform [0,C/2], independent of vertical Y1,Y2; changing sign of a uniform Y2 as necessary gives joint coupling D_cyl=sqrt(a^2+(Y2-Y1)^2), D_mob=min(D_cyl,sqrt((C-a)^2+(Y1+Y2)^2)). The extra parity route is at least C/2, proving equality before onset and stochastic domination. At a=C/2,Y1=H/2,Y2=-H/2, strict inequalities persist on a positive-volume neighbourhood for any r between C/2 and sqrt(C^2/4+H^2). Transform (V,W)=(Y1+Y2,Y2-Y1), whose density is 1/(2H^2) on |V|+|W|<=H; integrating the diamond gives 2(H-u)q-q^2 over CH^2 with exact limits. For r=C/2+epsilon, only a=C/2-t, 0<=t<=epsilon contributes; integrating v~sqrt(C(epsilon-t)) yields 8/(3H sqrt C)*epsilon^(3/2), with O(epsilon^2) remainder. Exact local disk integration gives F(r)=pi r^2/(CH)-4r^3/(3CH^2) for r<=min(C/2,H), identifying C and H, then strict CDF distinguishes orientability. Inspected proof applies to all aspect ratios; numerical checker is supplementary.
